coverageLimitations.reason: Key Vault certificates are data-plane objects. No equivalent management-plane certificate inventory/expiry aliases are exposed for a custom All/Indexed policy. Changing Microsoft.KeyVault.Data to All would not provide equivalent coverage. The unsupported clone is removed; use the supported built-in certificate-expiry control or a separately authorized data-plane certificate-monitoring process.

coverageLimitations.control: Service Health alert readiness — Billing updates
coverageLimitations.reason: Billing-type Service Health notifications are not recorded in the Azure subscription Activity Log (category=ServiceHealth); Microsoft's documentation states these notifications are visible only in the Azure Service Health portal/API, not the activity log. Because Microsoft.Insights/ActivityLogAlerts conditions evaluate activity-log events, there is no alias or data path by which a non-mutating Audit/AuditIfNotExists custom policy can verify a Billing-updates alert rule. Use Azure Service Health's native monitoring/notification configuration for this category instead of a custom Azure Policy audit.
